text: Branchpoint 是面向 DSH 网页端的会话分支插件。它在聊天标题栏加入分支按钮，从当前会话历史中整理可拆分的任务章节、理论章节、公式或代码片段，也可生成整条会话的摘要。选择内容后，插件创建新会话并把摘要放入输入框；完成分支后可返回主会话并准备一条进度说明。适合想把长对话按主题拆开、继续处理单项任务并保留主线的用户。

Branchpoint adds a fork button to DSH chats. It finds task sections, theory, formulas, and code, or summarizes a conversation. Choose content to start a focused session with its digest ready in the composer. Return to the parent with a prepared progress note.
想把长聊天里的某个章节单独开成新会话继续讨论。
DSH 能不能把对话中的公式或代码片段拆出来单独分析？
I want to split a topic from my current chat into a separate session.
Branchpoint 的「按内容分支」功能：点击聊天标题栏的分支按钮，可选择任务章节、理论章节、公式或代码片段；插件将所选内容整理成摘要，并在新会话输入框中准备好。

dsh-plugin-branchpoint README · Branchpoint：**Fork the conversation at a clean point.**

Branchpoint is a [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) (DSH) plugin that adds a fork button to the chat header. Click it and Branchpoint lists the sections it can split off — a practice set, a theory topic, a single formula or code fragment, or the whole branch. Pick one and it opens a fresh session with only that section's digest already in the composer.

dsh-plugin-branchpoint README · Branchpoint：Long chats degrade. Compaction helps, but it also blurs the thread. Branchpoint gives you a clean branch that still knows where you were.

dsh-plugin-branchpoint README · Topic branches：Branchpoint splits a structured lesson or project chat by its Markdown sections. A section with at least two numbered items under a task-like heading becomes a **task unit**; other sections with enough text become **theory units**. Selecting a unit creates a branch that knows only that part.

Example: the main chat has «Практика 2» after a change-of-base explanation. The picker shows «Практика 2 — 7 заданий». The new branch gets only this:

```text
🌿 Ветка 1 · 📝 Практика 2
🎯 Логарифмы

dsh-plugin-branchpoint README · Topic branches：1) $\log_4 8$

Formulas keep their original LaTeX, so the branch renders them with KaTeX exactly like the main chat. The picker still shows a readable preview (`log₄(8)`) because its rows are one line of plain text.

dsh-plugin-branchpoint README · «Разобрать»：Some parts of a lesson matter without being the topic itself: a formula, a function, a code fragment, a library. The picker lists them under **«Разобрать»**, after tasks and theory. Each row opens a narrow branch that carries only that item and the request «Разбери это отдельно, не углубляясь в остальную тему.»

```text
🌿 Ветка 2 · ∑ Формула: log_a(b) = (log_c(b)) / (log_c(a))
🎯 Логарифмы

$$

dsh-plugin-branchpoint README · Branch numbers and the main chat：Branchpoint numbers the branches of one parent: `🌿 Ветка 1 · …`, `🌿 Ветка 2 · …`. The number and the section name become the session title in the left panel, so two branches no longer look identical.

The root chat of a branch tree is renamed once to `🌳 …` and pinned, so it stays above its branches instead of getting lost among them. Only a real root gets the tree mark; a branch of a branch stays an ordinary `🌿` row.

dsh-plugin-branchpoint README · Branch numbers and the main chat：When «Практика 3» appears later, click the fork button again and split that section off. The main branch stays the map; each branch carries only its own tasks. That keeps context small and focused.

After you finish in the branch, click **↩**. Branchpoint opens the main branch and puts a short note in its composer, for example:

```text
↩️ «Логарифмы»: задания «Практика 2» выполнены (проверено 7).
```

dsh-plugin-branchpoint README · Install：Not on npm yet. Install the prebuilt tarball from the latest GitHub release:

```powershell
$tgz = "$env:TEMP\branchpoint.tgz"
Invoke-WebRequest "https://github.com/TimRad1/dsh-plugin-branchpoint/releases/latest/download/branchpoint.tgz" -OutFile $tgz
& "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" `
  plugin --profile desktop add ("file:" + ($tgz -replace '\\', '/'))

Or open **Settings → Plugins** in DSH and install the downloaded `.tgz` archive.
dsh-plugin-branchpoint README · Install：Fully quit and relaunch DSH. The desktop profile applies plugin composition at startup (it has no HMR).

dsh-plugin-branchpoint README · Use：1. Open an existing chat with at least one exchange.
2. Click the fork icon in the header.
3. Pick a task section, a theory section, a «Разобрать» item, or «Вся ветка».
4. Review the digest in the new session's composer and send it when ready.
5. When the branch is done, click **↩** in its header. The main branch opens with a note in the composer; edit or send it.

The button is hidden on a blank session: DSH hides the header actions until the session has history.
dsh-plugin-branchpoint README · How it works：No build step: `lib/client.js` is a ready ESM bundle in the `window.__ModuleLoader__` envelope.

dsh-plugin-branchpoint README · Limitations：- The digest is built from the **DSH session event log**. Reasoning and raw tool output are not summarized; only visible assistant text, tool errors, changed files and commands are used.
- The digest framing is English. Quoted conclusions stay in the language of the chat, since they are extracted verbatim.
- Section detection relies on Markdown headings (`## …`), bold headings (`**…**`), and numbered lists (`1. …`). A plain-prose chat may show no section rows; «Вся ветка» still works.
- A task section needs at least two numbered items; a theory section needs at least 160 characters.
- Formulas stay as LaTeX in the digest, so the branch renders them like the main chat after the message is sent. The composer itself is plain text: until you send, `$\log_2 32$` is visible as source.
- Branch numbers count only branches created by 0.6.0 or later for that parent; older branches keep their titles and do not consume a number.
- The **↩** button appears only for branches created by 0.5.0 or later, and only while the browser keeps the `localStorage` link.
- The tree mark and pin are applied once to the root chat when you first split a branch from i

dsh-plugin-branchpoint README · Development：```powershell
npm test
node --check lib/client.js
npm pack
```

To load local changes, install the new `.tgz` (or `link:<folder>`) and restart DSH.
